source: ATO Cycle I Storybook p.108-109 (PDF p.54)
_notes: Coordinates as 'RowCol' e.g. H10. Rows A..N bottom-to-top, columns 1..20 left-to-right, matching the printed board.
Primordial: Hekaton (2x2) on the centre space; facing determined by the arrow on the bottom Minor Trauma card (random direction).
Titan starting positions = the four flame markers.

Column = 1x1 Destructible Obstacle (Trap: push the Primordial onto it and roll d10 for negative Precision tokens). City = 3x3 tile; fissure shapes for level 4+ to be verified against the diagram (see TBC).
setup: Primordial Positioning: place the Hekaton on the indicated centre space; facing = arrow on bottom card of Minor Trauma deck.
Evolution: (campaign only - in Mnestis Theatre the level is chosen).
Additional Setup from Traits (e.g. Fissures at level IV+).

aftermath.victory: Primordial slain: BP cards in the Wound Stack >= Primordial's Wounds value.
aftermath.retreat: If 2+ Titans died, may retreat at the beginning of any Titan Round.

lv4-7._tbc: Required list says 11 Columns but 12 are readable from the diagram - verify which one is absent. Level 8+ uses the alternate Mnestis diagram (Rulebook p.72: 2x City, 11x Column, 2x Labyrinth I, 2x L, 1x O, 2x Z).
lv4-7._source: Storybook p.109 Level 4+ diagram (11 Column, 2 City, 2 Maze Fissure I, 1 O, 2 L) — read from scan.

lv8+._source: Core Rulebook p.73 'Hekaton level 8+' (Supersonic Punch alt diagram): 11 Column, 2 City, Labyrinth 2I/2L/1O/2Z. Read from a low-res diagram; only 10 Columns found.

terrainCards.Column: Obstacle. Obscuring. Destructible. Trap: If you push the Primordial onto this tile, remove the tile and roll a d10: 1-2 nothing; 3-8 place 1 negative Precision token in the Kratos Pool; 9-10 place 2.
terrainCards.City: [TBC which card] Modelled on Ruined City (3x3): Inhabited. Destructible (when the Primordial moves onto it or a Titan is involuntarily moved onto it, the tile is destroyed). Cover (Titans on this tile have +1 Evasion). Not an Obstacle. Termophylaed City variant: Obscuring. Cover. Inhabited (not destructible).
terrainCards.Maze Fissure: Chasm: Titans cannot voluntarily move through Chasm spaces. If a Titan ends their movement on a Chasm space, it dies. If it is Pushed Back or Pulled through a Chasm space, it dies. If a Chasm tile is placed under a Titan, it dies. Titans do not die from moving over a Chasm during Knockback unless they end on it.
